mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, measured by quarter-over-quarter percent change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in >40% of quarters with positive GDP acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth (year-over-year percent change) exceeds 3%, it signals strong demand that will drive positive earnings surprises and boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in >40% of months when INDPRO YoY growth > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate (0.5 percentage points or more) in a single month signals a rapidly tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in >40% of months following a 0.5pp UNRATE drop.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth (year-over-year percent change) exceeds 10%, it signals over-exuberance in the housing market that will lead to a demand slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in >40% of months when HOUST YoY growth > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in >40% of months when FEDFUNDS > 4% and rising.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales growth (year-over-year percent change) is negative for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening consumer demand environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS YoY growth < 0 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are positive in >40% of months following 2 consecutive months of negative RSAFS YoY growth.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth (month-over-month percent change) is positive and the unemployment rate is below 5%, it signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in >40% of months when PAYEMS MoM growth is positive and UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth (year-over-year percent change) is negative and the federal funds rate is above 2%, it signals a supply-driven slowdown in economic activity that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are positive in >40% of months when INDPRO YoY growth is negative and FEDFUNDS > 2%.
